parsed.scene_description: An indoor retail space viewed through glass doors. To the left, a wooden table holds various items including bottles and boxes. A red fire extinguisher is mounted on the wall near the door frame. Outside, a bench sits on a paved area with palm trees visible in the distance. The interior features shelves stocked with packaged goods to the right.

objects.label: glass doors
objects.observation: Double glass doors with vertical metal handles, positioned centrally. They are slightly ajar, revealing an outdoor area. A green emergency exit sign is mounted above them.

objects.label: wooden table
objects.observation: A wooden table with a dark top surface located on the left side of the image. It holds various items including bottles and boxes.

objects.label: fire extinguisher
objects.observation: A red fire extinguisher mounted on the wall near the right side of the door frame. It is partially obscured by a white object.

objects.label: shelves
objects.observation: Metal shelves stocked with various packaged goods located on the right side of the image. They are filled with bottles and boxes.
